Title: ADIRO Provenance Ontology
Description: Foundational, domain-neutral module for provenance. It lets any value inferred from a drawing be recorded as an assertion that carries its own source, confidence, and how it was produced, aligned to W3C PROV-O. It also holds the file a drawing is stored in, its pages, and the people and organisations a drawing names, aligned to ISO 21597-1 (ICDD). Part of ADIRO (AEC Drawing Information Representation Ontologies), a suite of six modules submitted separately (adprov, adgeom, admeta, adsym, adcore, adfacade) that share one repository DOI.
